youtube.title: Bananas Are Slightly Radioactive 🍌 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Every banana you've ever eaten was slightly radioactive.

Bananas are full of potassium. And a tiny bit of natural potassium is radioactive. Scientists even joke about measuring radiation in bananas. But don't worry. One banana gives you less radiation than an hour of ordinary life. Your body keeps its potassium level steady and flushes out the extra. And here's the twist. Your body has that same radioactive potassium. So you're slightly radioactive too. Right now.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.

#Shorts #science #food #physics #thehiddenwhy
